title: Turkish Bulgur Kisir Salad (Vegan)
description: A twist on the classic Turkish salad, made with bulgur, vegetables and a tangy dressing.

ingredients.name: Spice Blend (Turkish Red Pepper, Salt, Black Pepper)

instructions: Rinse the bulgur and soak it in water for 30 minutes. Drain and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine the diced onion, tomato, cucumber, and bell pepper.
Add the soaked bulgur to the bowl and mix well.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice and olive oil.
Pour the dressing over the bulgur mixture and toss to coat.
Sprinkle the spice blend over the top and serve.
